_comment: Single source of truth for the qubit-drive tables. Read by dgs/vector_potential_qubit.py (Python/Jupyter), learn/matlab/qubit_platforms_table.m (MATLAB) and used to generate learn/lean/QubitPlatforms.lean (Lean). Edit values HERE only, then rerun scripts/check_qubit_platforms_everywhere.sh. Platform values are illustrative orders of magnitude, not a specific device.

csus_lc_analog.label: CSUS bench: two coupled LC tanks (classical analog)

box_atom.label: electron in a 1 nm box driven by a laser field (toy artificial atom)
